meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: 它会检查 OneCLI 是否可用;若没有,就安装 OneCLI、配置 Agent Vault 网关,把 .env 里的凭据迁入保险库并移除明文密钥,随后重建并重启服务。过程中会询问保留或重新配置。
howto.when: 在用户执行 /init-onecli 时;或 /update-nanoclaw 更新引入 OneCLI 之后,以及首次搭建 OneCLI 时。

say.note: 触发安装与初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault。

say.text: 把 .env 里的 Anthropic 密钥迁入 OneCLI 保险库。
say.note: 会扫描 .env,迁移后删除明文密钥。

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,从零注册凭据。
say.note: 会放弃现有配置,执行重装流程。

howto.what_en: Checks if OneCLI exists. If not, installs it, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates credentials from .env into the vault, removes plaintext keys, rebuilds and restarts the service. It asks whether to keep or reconfigure current setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user invokes /init-onecli, after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or on first-time OneCLI setup.

say_en.note: Triggers install and initialization of the OneCLI Agent Vault.

say_en.text: Migrate the Anthropic keys from .env to the OneCLI vault.
say_en.note: It scans .env, migrates, then removes plaintext keys.

say_en.text: Reconfigure OneCLI and register credentials from scratch.
say_en.note: It discards current config and runs a fresh setup.
